summary: GDS Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of independent director and Audit Committee Chair Lim Ah Doo for personal reasons effective May 20, 2026, and the appointment of Hua (Kathy) Chen as his replacement on the same date. Ms. Chen is a U.S. CPA with over 30 years of financial experience and currently serves as Managing Partner and CFO of SB China Venture Capital. This is a routine board succession event with no special-situation catalyst, deal terms, or strategic change. No transaction, premium, or advisor involvement is mentioned.
